cardOverview.overviewText: A popular lifestyle card offering cashback on dining, groceries, and movies, with milestone vouchers and redemption flexibility for everyday users.

benefitRows.name: Swiggy Dineout
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy or Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 20% savings at 20,000+ partner restaurants. Complete the payment using your HDFC Freedom credit card to unlock the offer.
